subject: Charterly expansion: new projects, keys, and term amendment
messages:
From: Michael Tan <michael@charterly.io>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — two new projects & keys, pricing impact?

Hi Elliot,

Quick one from our side — we’re ready to onboard two additional internal projects (search-assist and doc-summarize) that will each require their own API keys and isolated rate limits. We currently run a single integration for core-chat and would like to keep these projects siloed for logging and quota reasons.

Questions:
- How does adding two projects affect our committed monthly spend and tier pricing?
- Is there a simple amendment you can route us for signature?
- Can you outline an activation schedule — we want to enable search-assist as a pilot the week of Oct 4, then roll doc-summarize two weeks later.

We’ll need the keys scoped to project-level usage and a short runbook for key rotation/dev/test separation. Can you also confirm whether we need any infra changes on Redwood’s side or if this is purely tenant config?

Thanks,
Michael
Senior Product Manager — Charterly
michael@charterly.io

---
Attachment: N/A

From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Tan <michael@charterly.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — two new projects & keys, pricing impact?

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear plan. We can support separate API keys and project scoping without any infra changes on your side; this is handled by tenant config and scoped routing. Quick answers up front:

- Pricing/commit: adding two new projects increases the committed units we recommend by ~45% given expected token volumes for search-assist (low latency) and doc-summarize (higher token churn). I’ll include a suggested amendment that increases the monthly commit and adds an explicit per-project key allotment.
- Amendment: I’ll circulate a draft amendment for signature (simple SOW-style addendum + updated pricing table).
- Schedule: Oct 4 pilot for search-assist sounds fine; doc-summarize staged two weeks after is workable. We’ll reserve a canary pool for the pilot to hit latency SLOs.

I’ll loop in Laura from Customer Success for rollout coordination and Marissa from Sales for the amendment and pricing. Expect a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Cheers,
Elliot Price
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
elliot_price@redwood.ai

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Charterly expansion: pricing + commit suggestion

Elliot — I ran the numbers with Ben. Quick internal notes for the amendment:

- Baseline: Charterly current commit = $18,000/mo (core-chat). Estimated incremental demand: +45% => recommended commit = $26,100/mo.
- Billing approach: keep the same monthly cadence, mark the two new projects as "Project A (search-assist)" and "Project B (doc-summarize)" in the contract. Add a single line item for reserved burst capacity (+10% for the first 60 days) to smooth pilot spikes.
- Terms: propose a 12-month extension on the current term to align with the new commit; include an opt-out window after 90 days with prorated true-up.
- SKUs/keys: create two project-scoped API keys under the existing tenant. CS will provide the runbook and a short rotation checklist.

Action items for Sales Ops/Billing (Ben): confirm whether we can offer a 5% discount on the incremental commit as a pilot incentive and if that impacts margin thresholds.

Marissa
Senior Account Manager — Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Charterly expansion: pricing + commit suggestion

Looping in billing ops notes — we can do the 5% incentive on the incremental portion; shown math below:

- Incremental commit (gross): $8,100/mo
- 5% pilot discount on incremental: -$405/mo
- Adjusted incremental: $7,695/mo
- New monthly invoice: $18,000 + $7,695 = $25,695/mo (round to $25,700 in contract text)

We’ll mention the temporary burst pool as a non-billable credit for first 60 days, then standard billing applies. Need Legal to sign off on the 90-day opt-out clause language — otherwise we can generate the amendment.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

---

From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Tan <michael@charterly.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Charterly expansion — amendment and next steps (DocuSign link + rollout)

Michael — thanks for the quick reply and timeline. Attached is the draft amendment (Charterly_Amendment_v1.docx) that captures: new per-project keys, updated monthly commit to $25,700, 12-month term extension, 90-day opt-out with prorated true-up, and a 60-day burst credit for pilot.

Key dates and ops plan:
- Sep 24: Amendment issued via DocuSign (link below).
- Oct 4: Search-assist pilot enabled — CS will provision project key and a canary pool. Laura will schedule a 30-min kickoff the week prior.
- Oct 18: Doc-summarize staged rollout (expand keys + rotate test keys).

Docs/links:
- Amendment (attached): Charterly_Amendment_v1.docx
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/CHRT-AMEND-2027
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/CHRT-2027-004

Things Laura/CS will deliver before pilot:
- Project key + runbook (dev/test/prod separation)
- Key rotation checklist and example scripts
- Latency/cost baseline for pilot (SLA expectations and rollback criteria)

Michael — once signed we’ll queue the keys and confirm the canary pool allocation. Let me know if you want the 90-day opt-out language tightened before we send.

Best,
Elliot Price
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
elliot_price@redwood.ai
